subject: nereid-origin
q: A dozen people now exist in this canon with nowhere to live in the schema.
detail:
DR. MARIANNE HATHAWAY and CASSANDRA ATHENA HATHAWAY, married, twelve daughters, nine born-affirmed and three born cis, three at a time, four pregnancies — luck rather than a rule of the bloodline. EDEN SEMIRAMIS NEREID, ID 00-400, codename Leviathan, 6'6", creator of Eden's Faultline and holder of the genetic lock on the Immutable Core — the prostate key Marianne could never edit out. APHRODITE FREYJA NEREID nee GRIMM, 5'4", formerly ATLAS CONRAD GRIMM, 6'9", 01-300, leader of the Hounds and Bryn's rival inside. QUINN is Eden's younger sister. The other Hounds have names: Doberman, Bulldog, Wolfhound, Shepherd, and Rottweiler, who was Atlas. RAGNAR and JAMES. NONA VALENTINA. Luna's late grandmother. Torie and Alice's mother. Siren's sister, 09-156, unnamed. The nurse who smuggled Nova out. The master electrician who grinned.

The girls collection is built around Haven residency and a devotion-locked pairing, and none of these people fit it. They are currently held inside system entries, which is a holding pattern rather than an answer.

ANSWERED 7 SEPTEMBER. Viraena approved a PEOPLE collection. RETIRED — the build remains to be done.
